ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a circle with L as the center, and H, I, J, K, G are all on the circle; IG is a vertical diameter, and HK is a diagonal diameter. The central angle between radii LH and LI is labeled as 59°. The problem asks to find the measure of arc HI. Because the central angle corresponding to minor arc HI is ∠HLI, and the measure of a minor arc is equal to the measure of the central angle it subtends, so m\widehat{HI} = 59°.

Read the text: HK and IG are diameters of circle L, and the task is to find the measure of arc HI. Since the measure of a minor arc equals the measure of its intercepted central angle, arc HI has measure 59°.
